what: sha-pinned copies of the identity-census corpus files for this entry. sha256 / size pin the bytes on disk, which every battery and self-test leg refuses on drift; record_sha256 / record_size are the digest and size of the original corpus file. The two differ where a comment or an unread configuration line (a local path, a provenance note) was rewritten in the copy; no field a reader consumes differs. source is the corpus-relative name (identity_census/rows/<row>/<file>).
